checklist.title: Experiments compute resources
checklist.justification: The paper does not report specific compute resources. All experiments are lightweight (closed-form linear algebra on small-to-moderate datasets) and run on a standard laptop CPU in minutes. No GPU is required. Single-threaded timings of one ROLS fit are reported in Appendix H.8.
